entries.label: Alternative Rock
entries.insert: alternative rock
entries.description: A broad rock identity suited to modern or era-specific refinement.

entries.label: Dark Folk
entries.insert: dark folk with organic acoustic weight
entries.description: A restrained folk identity emphasizing acoustic texture and shadowed tone.

entries.label: Progressive Metal
entries.insert: progressive metal with deliberate rhythmic contrast
entries.description: Heavy music built around evolving structure and rhythmic development.

entries.label: Dark Synthwave
entries.insert: dark synthwave with industrial tension
entries.description: Synth-driven retro-futurist identity with darker mechanical character.

entries.label: Neo-Soul
entries.insert: modern neo-soul with late-1970s harmonic warmth
entries.description: Modern soul language with warm harmony and a relaxed pocket.

entries.label: Ambient Instrumental
entries.insert: slow-evolving ambient instrumental
entries.description: Texture-first instrumental identity with gradual development.

entries.label: Cinematic Pop
entries.insert: cinematic pop with a restrained alternative-rock edge
entries.description: Pop songwriting framed by controlled cinematic scale and rock texture.

entries.label: Industrial Trip-Hop
entries.insert: industrial trip-hop with slow broken beats and mechanical tension
entries.description: A dark electronic identity pairing broken-beat motion with industrial texture.

entries.label: Dream Pop
entries.insert: dream pop with hazy guitars and a clear melodic center
entries.description: Atmospheric pop that retains an intelligible hook beneath the texture.

entries.label: Indie Folk
entries.insert: intimate indie folk with natural acoustic texture
entries.description: Small-scale acoustic songwriting with an organic performance character.

entries.label: Orchestral Hybrid
entries.insert: modern orchestral hybrid with electronic low-end support
entries.description: Orchestral writing reinforced by selective electronic production.

entries.label: Melodic House
entries.insert: melodic house with a warm club pulse and restrained progressive build
entries.description: Four-on-the-floor electronic music focused on melody and gradual development.

entries.label: Jazz Fusion
entries.insert: modern jazz fusion with elastic rhythm and electric instrumentation
entries.description: Jazz harmony and improvisational movement carried by a contemporary electric ensemble.

entries.label: Raw Punk Rock
entries.insert: raw punk rock with direct songwriting and live-room urgency
entries.description: Compact rock identity emphasizing immediacy over polished density.

entries.label: Straight Driving Pulse
entries.insert: straight driving pulse with steady forward motion
entries.description: A consistent, unswung feel that maintains momentum.

entries.label: Slow Heavy Backbeat
entries.insert: slow heavy backbeat with a double-time hi-hat feel
entries.description: Slow primary pulse with faster subdivision above it.

entries.label: Loose Swung Feel
entries.insert: loose swung groove with relaxed behind-the-beat placement
entries.description: Human rhythmic movement with a relaxed swing.

entries.label: Syncopated Accents
entries.insert: syncopated accents against a stable underlying pulse
entries.description: Off-beat emphasis while retaining a clear rhythmic anchor.

entries.label: Slow 6/8 Feel
entries.insert: slow 6/8 feel with a broad rolling pulse
entries.description: Compound-meter motion appropriate for ballads and cinematic folk.

entries.label: Four-on-the-Floor
entries.insert: urgent four-on-the-floor pulse with continuous eighth-note bass movement
entries.description: Steady dance pulse supported by continuously moving bass.

entries.label: Halftime Weight
entries.insert: halftime groove with a heavy backbeat and spacious subdivisions
entries.description: Creates perceived weight by slowing the backbeat while preserving the underlying tempo.

entries.label: Tight Mechanical Grid
entries.insert: tight mechanical pulse with clipped subdivisions and minimal swing
entries.description: A rigid electronic time feel suited to industrial or synth-driven music.

entries.label: Laid-Back Pocket
entries.insert: laid-back pocket with the snare slightly behind the beat
entries.description: Relaxed groove defined by placement rather than a vague slow-tempo request.

entries.label: Broken-Beat Groove
entries.insert: broken-beat groove with syncopated kick placement and a stable sub pulse
entries.description: Irregular drum motion anchored by consistent low-frequency movement.

entries.label: Waltz Pulse
entries.insert: measured 3/4 waltz pulse with a clear first-beat emphasis
entries.description: Triple-meter movement with an unmistakable downbeat.

entries.label: Muted Guitar Carries Verses
entries.insert: muted guitar carries the verses with restrained rhythmic figures
entries.description: Assigns guitar a specific supportive role instead of merely listing it.

entries.label: Bass Locks to Kick
entries.insert: bass locks tightly to the kick during the main groove
entries.description: Defines a direct rhythmic relationship between bass and drums.

entries.label: Piano Harmonic Anchor
entries.insert: piano provides the harmonic anchor with restrained voicings
entries.description: Keeps piano central without requiring constant density.

entries.label: Strings Rise Into Chorus
entries.insert: strings enter gradually before the chorus and sustain behind the hook
entries.description: Gives strings a timed arrangement function.

entries.label: Full Drums Only in Chorus
entries.insert: full live drums arrive only in the chorus
entries.description: Uses the drum entrance to create section contrast.

entries.label: Fingerpicked Guitar Pulse
entries.insert: fingerpicked acoustic guitar establishes the pulse with repeating figures
entries.description: Gives acoustic guitar a rhythmic foundation role.

entries.label: Rhodes Extended Voicings
entries.insert: Rhodes carries the harmony with warm extended voicings
entries.description: Defines both the keyboard sound and its harmonic function.

entries.label: Guitar Phrase Answers
entries.insert: clean guitar answers the vocal with short phrases between lines
entries.description: Creates call-and-response without crowding the lead vocal.

entries.label: Sequenced Synth Bass
entries.insert: sequenced analog bass drives continuous eighth notes beneath the groove
entries.description: Assigns bass a continuous propulsive role.

entries.label: Melodic Bass Support
entries.insert: bass moves melodically in the gaps while staying behind the vocal
entries.description: Allows bass movement while protecting vocal space.

entries.label: Low Bowed-String Bed
entries.insert: low bowed strings sustain a dark harmonic bed beneath the arrangement
entries.description: Uses strings as sustained foundation instead of generic decoration.

entries.label: Delayed Frame-Drum Entry
entries.insert: frame drum enters after the opening section with a restrained heartbeat pattern
entries.description: Adds acoustic percussion at a deliberate point in the arc.

entries.label: Guitars Open in Chorus
entries.insert: palm-muted guitars in the verse open into sustained voicings in the chorus
entries.description: Creates section contrast by changing articulation rather than adding another instrument.

entries.label: Tom Build Transition
entries.insert: a restrained tom build carries the transition into the next section
entries.description: Gives drums a clear transition function.

entries.label: Pads Stay Behind Lead
entries.insert: soft synth pads remain wide and behind the lead without masking it
entries.description: Defines the pad's supportive position and prevents foreground competition.

entries.label: Close and Conversational
entries.insert: close and conversational vocal delivery with clear articulation
entries.description: An intimate lead that remains understandable and human.

entries.label: Warm Baritone
entries.insert: warm baritone lead with controlled chest voice
entries.description: Low male register with controlled weight rather than exaggerated grit.

entries.label: Low Female Alto
entries.insert: clear low female alto with minimal vibrato
entries.description: Low female register with restrained ornamentation.

entries.label: Restrained Verse Delivery
entries.insert: restrained and speech-like in the verses
entries.description: Keeps verse intensity controlled to preserve contrast.

entries.label: Sustained Chorus Notes
entries.insert: opens into longer sustained notes at chorus peaks without shouting
entries.description: Creates vocal lift through duration and intensity rather than volume alone.

entries.label: Final-Chorus Harmony
entries.insert: two-part backing harmony enters only in the final chorus
entries.description: Reserves backing harmony for the final payoff.

entries.label: Whispered Delivery
entries.insert: [Whisper]
entries.description: Common community metatag for whispered delivery; results remain soft and model-dependent.

entries.label: Warm Female Mezzo
entries.insert: warm female mezzo lead with a clear midrange and controlled chest voice
entries.description: Mid-register female lead described through mechanics rather than vague emotion.

entries.label: Controlled Male Tenor
entries.insert: low male tenor with detached, controlled phrasing
entries.description: A focused tenor delivery that avoids automatic shouting or theatricality.

entries.label: Breathy Head Voice
entries.insert: breathy head voice on softer phrases with clear consonants
entries.description: Balances softness with intelligibility.

entries.label: Controlled Rasp at Peaks
entries.insert: controlled rasp appears only on emphasized words at section peaks
entries.description: Scopes vocal grain to specific moments so it does not dominate the track.

entries.label: Minimal Melisma
entries.insert: direct melodic phrasing with minimal melisma and few vocal runs
entries.description: Keeps the melody direct and the lyric intelligible.

entries.label: Stable Vocal Character
entries.insert: keep vocal tone, loudness, and density stable across the entire track
entries.description: Counters unwanted late-song changes in vocal character.

entries.label: Final-Chorus Octave Harmony
entries.insert: add octave harmony only to the final chorus hook
entries.description: Saves octave reinforcement for a specific payoff.

entries.label: Close Crooning
entries.insert: close crooning delivery with restrained dynamics and short phrase endings
entries.description: An intimate sung delivery with controlled intensity.

entries.label: Gradual Build
entries.insert: the arrangement builds gradually by adding one meaningful layer at each section
entries.description: Creates development through staged layer additions.

entries.label: Strip Down the Bridge
entries.insert: strip the bridge to voice and one supporting instrument
entries.description: Creates contrast before the final return.

entries.label: Final-Chorus Lift
entries.insert: rebuild into the final chorus with wider instrumentation and stronger harmony
entries.description: Defines concrete changes that create the final payoff.

entries.label: Rhythmic Dropout
entries.insert: drop drums and bass briefly before the next section enters
entries.description: Uses temporary absence to strengthen the following entrance.

entries.label: Instrumental Section
entries.insert: [Instrumental]
entries.description: Common structural directive for a section without lead lyrics.

entries.label: Solo Section
entries.insert: [Solo]
entries.description: Common structural directive for an instrumental spotlight.

entries.label: Silence
entries.insert: [Silence]
entries.description: Community-tested pause directive; not deterministic or officially documented syntax.

entries.label: Controlled Crescendo
entries.insert: increase intensity gradually through denser rhythm and stronger articulation
entries.description: Defines how intensity grows instead of relying on the word epic.

entries.label: Pre-Chorus Pullback
entries.insert: pull drums and bass back briefly before the chorus entrance
entries.description: Creates chorus impact through a brief reduction before the downbeat.

entries.label: Instruments Fall Away
entries.insert: remove layers one by one until only the final sustaining element remains
entries.description: Provides a controlled decrescendo or outro shape.

entries.label: Bring Hook Forward
entries.insert: introduce the central hook early, then return with fuller support
entries.description: Establishes the main motif early while preserving room for growth.

entries.label: Final Lift Without Key Change
entries.insert: create the final lift through width, harmony, and articulation without a key change
entries.description: Specifies concrete lift mechanisms while excluding an unwanted modulation.

entries.label: Clean Resolved Ending
entries.insert: end with a clean resolved final chord rather than a fade
entries.description: Requests a deliberate ending shape instead of an indefinite fade.

entries.label: Breakdown Section
entries.insert: [Breakdown]
entries.description: Common metatag for a reduced or rhythm-focused section; execution remains model-dependent.

entries.label: Interlude
entries.insert: [Interlude]
entries.description: Common metatag for a short connective section.

entries.label: Vocal-Forward Mix
entries.insert: clear vocal-forward mix with the lead above guitars and synths
entries.description: Defines the vocal as the primary foreground element.

entries.label: Dry and Close
entries.insert: dry close-miked lead with short room ambience only
entries.description: Reduces washed-out vocals and excessive depth.

entries.label: Wide Chorus Image
entries.insert: broaden the stereo image in the chorus while keeping the lead centered
entries.description: Uses width for section lift without losing vocal focus.

entries.label: Natural Dynamics
entries.insert: preserve natural dynamics with restrained master compression
entries.description: Avoids a uniformly flattened or over-polished result.

entries.label: Controlled Low End
entries.insert: controlled low end with clear kick and bass separation
entries.description: Keeps low-frequency elements distinct.

entries.label: Short Natural Room
entries.insert: short natural room ambience with clear early reflections
entries.description: Adds space without pushing the performance far into the background.

entries.label: Warm Tape Character
entries.insert: warm tape-like texture with softened transients and subtle instability
entries.description: Requests audible analog character through concrete traits.

entries.label: Raw Live-Room Sound
entries.insert: raw live-room sound with audible pick noise and natural drum transients
entries.description: Introduces deliberate human imperfection and room character.

entries.label: Dark Tonal Balance
entries.insert: dark tonal balance with controlled upper mids and clear vocal presence
entries.description: Darkens the mix while preserving lead intelligibility.

entries.label: Bright Transient Detail
entries.insert: bright open top end with crisp transients and no harsh vocal sibilance
entries.description: Requests clarity and attack while limiting harshness.

entries.label: Centered Punchy Bass
entries.insert: centered punchy bass with wide guitars kept outside the vocal space
entries.description: Establishes a clear spatial relationship among bass, guitars, and vocal.

entries.label: Large Dynamic Range
entries.insert: large dynamic range with quiet sections left genuinely quiet
entries.description: Preserves meaningful loudness contrast across the arrangement.

entries.label: Exclude Trap Hi-Hats
entries.insert: trap hi-hats
entries.description: Prevents an unwanted rhythmic production convention.

entries.label: Exclude Long Vocal Reverb
entries.insert: long vocal reverb and washed vocals
entries.description: Keeps the lead close and intelligible.

entries.label: Exclude Constant Choir
entries.insert: constant choir and excessive backing vocals
entries.description: Reserves group vocals for intentional moments.

entries.label: Exclude Overcompression
entries.insert: overcompressed drums and flattened dynamics
entries.description: Protects transient detail and dynamic contrast.

entries.label: Exclude Excessive Melisma
entries.insert: excessive melisma and constant vocal runs
entries.description: Keeps phrasing direct when ornamentation is unwanted.

entries.label: Exclude Constant Ad-Libs
entries.insert: constant ad-libs and crowded vocal fills
entries.description: Prevents vocal decoration from filling every available gap.

entries.label: Exclude Festival Risers
entries.insert: EDM festival risers and oversized impact effects
entries.description: Avoids a specific large-scale electronic transition convention.

entries.label: Exclude Choir Pads
entries.insert: choir pads and vocal-like synth textures
entries.description: Keeps instrumental beds from resembling background voices.

entries.label: Exclude Bright Tropical Synths
entries.insert: bright tropical synths and playful pluck leads
entries.description: Blocks a bright electronic palette when it conflicts with the intended identity.

entries.label: Exclude Operatic Delivery
entries.insert: operatic projection and theatrical vibrato
entries.description: Keeps a vocal performance intimate and contemporary.

entries.label: Exclude Constant Screaming
entries.insert: constant screaming and unbroken vocal distortion
entries.description: Reserves harsh vocal texture for deliberate moments.

entries.label: Exclude Trailer Crescendo
entries.insert: dramatic trailer crescendo and oversized orchestral impacts
entries.description: Prevents ambient or restrained music from drifting into trailer scoring.

entries.label: Exclude Key Change
entries.insert: final-chorus key change
entries.description: Requests that the final lift come from arrangement rather than modulation.

entries.label: Exclude Fade-Out
entries.insert: fade-out ending
entries.description: Encourages a deliberate resolved or abrupt ending instead of a fade.
